name: Fennel, Zucchini, Corn & Feta Frittata with Kale-Tomato Pine Nut Salad

cookwares.name: stainless steel or cast iron skillet

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ lemons
3 fennel bulbs
3 medium zucchini squash
1 ½ bunches kale
1 ½ small pkgs grape tomatoes

instructions.primary_message: Juice lemons into a large bowl. Add mayo, Dijon, honey, salt, and pepper, then whisk to combine the dressing. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp mayonnaise
1 tbsp Dijon mustard
1 tbsp honey
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Trim off root end and stalks of the fennel, leaving only the white bulb. Halve fennel bulb lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin half-moons. Place in another large bowl.
Preheat a large ovenproof skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, trim and quarter zucchini lengthwise, then cut crosswise into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl with the fennel.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add fennel, zucchini, corn, and salt; cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies are tender but not browned, 5-6 minutes. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ cups frozen corn
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, crack eggs into the reserved bowl. Add half of the feta (reserving the rest for the salad) and spices, then whisk to combine. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
18 eggs
1 ½ (113 g) pkgs crumbled feta cheese
1 ½ tsp parsley flakes
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven.

When the veggies are tender, pour the egg mixture into the skillet. As eggs set around the edge of the skillet, gently lift cooked portions with a spatula to allow uncooked egg to flow underneath. Cook until bottom and sides are firm but top is still runny, 5-7 minutes.
Place skillet in the oven and broil until top of the frittata is just set, 3-4 minutes. Remove from oven.

Meanwhile, fold kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems; cut leaves crosswise into thin (shred-like) pieces. Add to the bowl with the dressing. Using your hands, massage kale with the dressing until wilted, 1-2 minutes.
Halve grape tomatoes. Add to the bowl, along with reserved feta and pine nuts, then toss to combine the salad.
Cut frittata into wedges and divide between plates. Serve with salad on the side and enjoy!
